title: Emacs: code execution on file open
description: An ordinary file. An unexpected execution path. How Emacs directory locals bypassed the very check meant to keep them safe.
seoDescription: CVE-2026-131959: a .dir-locals.el file could run arbitrary Emacs Lisp on file open in Emacs 31.1. Root cause, working PoCs, and the 31.2 patch.
label: Upstream fix

preview.caption: The matcher called the remembered function before the caller validated the returned mode.

title: Hermes Agent: unauthenticated RCE
description: An exposed session token in Hermes Agent turns a dashboard visit into unauthenticated code execution and credential access.
label: Hermes Agent

preview.caption: With --insecure enabled, the page exposed the token used to authorize subsequent API requests.

title: Bun install: arbitrary file write
description: A dependency alias takes Bun outside node_modules. Arbitrary file writes, even with lifecycle scripts disabled.
label: Bun

preview.caption: An absolute dependency alias became an installation destination outside node_modules.

title: Git FSMonitor: workspace poisoning
description: When Git-aware editors trust a poisoned workspace, a routine status check can become local code execution.
label: Git FSMonitor

preview.caption: A poisoned workspace configuration can execute a local hook when an editor checks Git status.
